update.name: SonicWall-SMA1000-Zero-Day-IoC-Check
update.description: Unofficial Bash IoC checker for SonicWall SMA1000 appliances affected by actively exploited CVE-2026-15409 and CVE-2026-15410.

update.name: rapid7-CVE-2026-15409
update.description: This repo contains a proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2026-15409. It establishes non-root remote code execution on SonicWall SMA 1000 by implementing the Erlang protocol expected by localhost:1050 and tunneling it through the websocket for file r/w and arbitrary code execution via RPC calls.
